result:
If I could change the world in one way, I would make empathy easier than indifference.

Not because everyone would suddenly agree, but because people would more often pause long enough to understand one another before reacting. So much harm—conflict, cruelty, neglect, polarization—comes from an inability or unwillingness to imagine what another person feels. If empathy were more instinctive, many other things would improve: justice would be fairer, leadership would be kinder, and solutions would be built with more care for the people they affect.
